Ashe.combo: For a standard trade, build as many Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To root Ashe with Varus R Chain of Corruption and start a fight, use R → E → Q to detonate the stacks twice. If you end up fighting at close range, don't charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long, since charging it slows Varus.
Ashe.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, use it to clear the wave and poke, and look to trade right after Ashe W Volley is down. If you don't have lane priority or the enemy jungler's position is unknown, don't walk up to charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Ashe.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Mercurial Scimitar earlier.
Ashe.escape: The chance to engage comes when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has expired. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down too, the risk of being stunned is lower, giving you a chance to root Ashe with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Varus has no mobility ability, so don't chase on foot through Ashe P Frost Shot's slow.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has expired. Varus has no mobility ability, so don't try to walk into range through Ashe P Frost Shot's slow. Build Blighted Quiver stacks when you can safely basic attack, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If you get an angle to hit Ashe with Varus R Chain of Corruption, start the fight with its root.
Ashe.phase: You need to hold your position and fight in the late game, even when you have firepower, because you have no mobility ability.
Ashe.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies overlap. Watch out for Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, and don't walk forward to basic attack before the enemy's engage tools are down. When you get a takedown, attack the next target while Varus P Living Vengeance empowers you.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is a cone-shaped poke that slows, so dodge it by moving sideways. Ashe Q Ranger's Focus increases her damage, so create distance until it expires. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns, so don't start a small skirmish from outside vision while her ultimate is available; change direction to dodge if it comes your way.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its indicator suggests, so avoid standing directly behind minions when Lucian farms. Lucian R The Culling cannot change direction while channeling, so sidestep instead of running straight back. Move away to avoid his empowered attacks right after Lucian receives a shield or heal, or an ally is immobilized.
Lucian.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Lucian’s main damage is physical and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Lucian.combo: Your basic trade is to build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then follow with Varus E Hail of Arrows and Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If he gets close, fire Varus Q Piercing Arrow immediately instead of charging it fully.
Lucian.escape: The moment after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your chance to engage.
Lucian.fight: Wait out Lucian’s first ability combo, then counterattack before the abilities he used come back up. Build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Lucian.laning: Don’t stand directly behind a minion when Lucian uses Lucian Q Piercing Light on it. Don’t charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long in front of the wave before checking the availability of Lucian E Relentless Pursuit and the enemy jungler’s position.
Lucian.phase: Varus gets stronger as you build items, but he still has no mobility in the late game, so hold your position while fighting.
Lucian.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption to engage when enemies group together. Don’t walk forward to land basic attacks before Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down. If you contribute to a takedown, use the power spike from Varus P Living Vengeance to advance on the next target.

Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, so the chance to engage comes after Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or Jinx W Zap! misses. Root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption then, but Varus has no mobility ability, so don't walk forward recklessly if the enemy jungler's position is unknown.
Jinx.build: Start by buying Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx's main damage is physical, and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.combo: For a standard trade, build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Jinx's root is down and you can reliably catch her, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Jinx.fight: Build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or Jinx W Zap! misses, look for a chance to root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and attack.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx hits minions with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo!, avoid standing beside the minions, and use abilities to detonate Blighted Quiver stacks built with basic attacks. If the jungler's position is unknown, don't charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long in front of the wave.
Jinx.phase: Survive the early game by poking with the bonus damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver, and use the fact that Jinx has no minigun attack speed stacks while using rockets. Even as Varus's damage grows stronger in the late game, he has no mobility ability, so hold your position in fights.
Jinx.teamfight: Use Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline. When Jinx is grouped with another enemy, look to root them and spread the effect with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Don't walk forward to basic attack before the enemy's engage tools are down. If a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, attack the next target.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rockets also deal damage around minions, so don't stand next to a minion when Jinx farms. Dodge the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and don't stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! when your health is low.

Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early laning phase, so survive and farm without giving up a kill. She gets relatively weaker as the game goes on, but Varus still has no mobility ability in the late game, so position carefully.
Caitlyn.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Caitlyn deals mostly physical damage, and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Caitlyn.combo: For a short trade, build Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Blighted Quiver stacks build while Varus R Chain of Corruption roots her, so you can detonate them with the two follow-up abilities.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for an opening right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave. Build Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Caitlyn.laning: Don't force trades into Caitlyn's strong early laning. If you don't have lane priority, farm under your turret and clear the wave with your abilities.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group up. If you get a takedown, move on to the next target while Varus P Living Vengeance empowers you.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you'll be rooted and take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot's increased range. Watch for traps in brush and narrow passages. Dodge Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker from behind allied minions so the minions get hit first.

Smolder.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Much of Smolder’s damage is physical, and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Counter the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! with the healing reduction from Varus E Hail of Arrows; consider a healing reduction item only when the enemy has multiple sources of healing or heals outside E’s range.
Smolder.combo: Stack Blight to its maximum with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down and you can start a fight with Varus R Chain of Corruption, use R → E → Q. Blight stacks build during R’s root, so E and Q can detonate them twice.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only mobility spell that lets him escape over terrain, so right after he uses it is your chance to engage. Hit him with Varus R Chain of Corruption then to keep him from getting away. If Smolder W Achooo! slows you, you’ll be vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so dodge W before closing the gap.
Smolder.fight: Pressure Smolder while he is weak in the early game, but Varus has no mobility, so don’t step forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow when the enemy jungler’s position is unconfirmed. For trades, stack Blight with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Once Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption and fight.
Smolder.laning: To slow the growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice, make it difficult for Smolder to last-hit while dodging your harass from the early game onward. When you don’t have lane priority, don’t force your way forward; clear the wave with abilities.
Smolder.phase: The early game, before Smolder has built up growth stacks, is when Varus should pressure him. In the mid game, play to quickly take objectives and turrets and end the game. As time passes, Smolder gains an advantage from the permanent growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice.
Smolder.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, then cast Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies are grouped. Step forward to use basic attacks only after enemy engage abilities, including Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, are down. A takedown empowers Varus with Varus P Living Vengeance, so immediately attack the next target.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes when it hits a champion, grants growth stacks, and slows, so dodge it by standing behind minions or moving sideways. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so step out of the flames, then re-engage. Watch out for the true damage and execute from a grown Smolder’s Q Super Scorcher Breath.

Seraphine.fight: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to fight. When Seraphine is separated from her allies, build Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks and detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Varus has no escape ability, so keep your distance while Seraphine’s crowd control is available.
Seraphine.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor to defend against Seraphine’s damage. If the enemy composition has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, get Mercurial Scimitar earlier. Varus E Hail of Arrows can reduce healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound, so healing reduction items are a low priority.
Seraphine.combo: Your basic trade is to build Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you can safely fight, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then hit her with Varus E Hail of Arrows followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Blighted Quiver stacks build while she is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, so detonate them with the two abilities in turn.
Seraphine.escape: Close the gap right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop. Seraphine has no mobility, so if you root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption then, she’ll have a hard time escaping. If Seraphine’s crowd control is still available, don’t dive in first with Varus, who has no mobility.
Seraphine.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, clear the wave while placing its healing reduction zone where Seraphine will stand. If you don’t have lane priority, don’t step forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow; focus on clearing the wave.
Seraphine.phase: Even after building items in the late game, Varus still has no mobility, so hold your position and attack when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down.
Seraphine.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group together. Spread out to the left and right to prevent Seraphine R Encore from extending through your allies. Step forward to land basic attacks after the enemy’s engage tools are down. If you contribute to a takedown and trigger Varus P Living Vengeance, move on to the next target.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, get out of the line directly in front of Seraphine. In teamfights, don’t stand in a line, as Seraphine R Encore can extend its range through allies.

Aphelios.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and spread out from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn't hit you all together. When enemies group up, root several with Varus R Chain of Corruption, but consider saving it as a defensive tool if an enemy is on top of you. Basic attack after the enemy's engage tools are down, and move on to the next target if a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance.
Aphelios.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Varus has low armor, so build armor first. Even if healing is troublesome, Varus E Hail of Arrows can apply Grievous Wounds. Buy Mortal Reminder in place of an armor penetration item only when there are multiple sources of healing or healing occurs beyond E's reach.
Aphelios.combo: For short trades, build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To reliably catch Aphelios and start a fight, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Stacks build during R's root, so you can detonate them with E and Q.
Aphelios.escape: Close the distance after dodging Aphelios's Gravitum slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, or after those tools are down. When Aphelios isn't holding Severum, his mobility is limited, so look for a chance to root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption. If he still has a way to catch you, place Varus E Hail of Arrows along the approach path and keep your distance.
Aphelios.fight: Check Aphelios's current and next weapons, and trade when he has a weapon with low immediate burst. Build stacks of Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Aphelios still has a way to catch you, keep your distance first, since Varus has no escape ability.
Aphelios.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, clear the wave by detonating stacks built with basic attacks, and place its contaminated ground where Aphelios will heal. Retreat to preserve your health if marked by Calibrum or slowed by Gravitum. When you don't have lane priority, don't walk up and charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long.
Aphelios.phase: Even with several items, Varus has no mobility ability, so hold your position and deal damage in the late game.
Aphelios.watch: When Aphelios slows you with a Gravitum basic attack, immediately retreat beyond range to avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil applies one extra main-hand weapon attack to every champion it hits, so spread out from your allies when he can cast it. If marked by Calibrum, retreat: he can hit you with a follow-up attack from beyond his normal range.

Kaisa.phase: Kai'Sa also gets stronger as she builds items, so Varus should hold his position and move forward after her engage tool is down.
Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Kai’Sa’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If you also need to withstand the magic damage from Kai’Sa P Second Skin and Kai’Sa W Void Seeker, build both magic resistance and health.
Kaisa.combo: Your basic trade is to build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. When Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct is down and you can catch her, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Kai’Sa gets close, don’t try to fully charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow; fire it immediately.
Kaisa.escape: Root Kai’Sa with Varus R Chain of Corruption then, and she’ll have a hard time escaping. Conversely, if Kai’Sa W Void Seeker hits you and the mark remains, don’t engage; retreat toward your allies.
Kaisa.fight: Stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate the stacks with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct is available, decide whether to hold Varus R Chain of Corruption to respond to her engage.
Kaisa.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, detonate stacks built with basic attacks while also clearing the wave. When you expect Kai’Sa Q Icathian Rain, stay near allied minions rather than standing alone away from the wave. If you can’t confirm the engage threat, don’t step forward and charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long.
Kaisa.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and look for Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group together. If Kai’Sa dives in with Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption before her shield is removed and focus her down. Before the fight, place Control Wards in the side brush and along her approach routes to prepare for Kai’Sa E Supercharge’s stealth. If you contribute to a takedown and trigger Varus P Living Vengeance, move on to the next target.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai’Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you can become a target for Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Stand near allied minions when Kai’Sa uses Kai’Sa Q Icathian Rain so the missiles spread out. If you have low health and Kai’Sa P Second Skin stacks are on you, move out of her range and wait for the stacks to expire.

Draven.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Draven's main damage is physical, and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Also consider your total health in light of the execute threshold on Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: For a standard trade, build as many Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Target Draven's axe landing spots to hit him with an ability or make him drop an axe. To start a fight, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then detonate the Blighted Quiver stacks that build during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Draven.escape: Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage after Draven E Stand Aside is down. Close the distance when he has one or fewer Draven Q Spinning Axes, then root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Draven.fight: Don't fight when Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes; look to trade when he has one or fewer. Place Varus E Hail of Arrows or fire Varus Q Piercing Arrow where an axe will land, forcing Draven to either take the hit or give up the axe. If an opportunity to close the distance comes up, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Draven.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, use it to clear the wave and poke the spots where Draven's axes will land. If trading is difficult, farm safely without giving Draven a kill. If the wave pushes toward your side and Draven walks forward, look for a play with your jungler.
Draven.phase: In the early game, Varus needs to hold on without trading into Draven when he has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Varus gets stronger as he builds items in the late game, but he has no mobility ability, so hold your position in fights.
Draven.teamfight: Poke with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and target Draven's axe landing spots. If enemies group up, root them with Varus R Chain of Corruption, but save R if you need it to stop an enemy from getting on top of you. Basic attack after the enemy's engage tools are down, and move forward to the next target if a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven E Stand Aside knocks or pulls Varus and slows him, so don't walk up while Draven can use it. Draven R Whirling Death returns and can execute low-health enemies, so fully leave its path even after dodging the first hit.

Ezreal.combo: For a short trade, build as many Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. After Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, root him first with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then detonate the Blighted Quiver stacks that build during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Ezreal.escape: The window to engage is right after you make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift. However, repeated hits from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot make Ezreal E Arcane Shift come back sooner, so approach with minions between you and him, then root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Ezreal.fight: Build Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Force Ezreal to use Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then immediately close the distance and start a fight by rooting him with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Varus has no mobility ability, so don't walk forward recklessly while Ezreal E Arcane Shift is available.
Ezreal.laning: Move with minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If you don't have lane priority, or Ezreal E Arcane Shift and the enemy jungler's position are unaccounted for, don't walk up and charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long.
Ezreal.phase: Varus gets stronger as he builds items, but he has no mobility ability even in the late game, so hold your position in fights.
Ezreal.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group up. If you get a takedown, move on to the next target while Varus P Living Vengeance empowers you.
Ezreal.watch: Block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions. Avoid getting hit repeatedly, since it also reduces Ezreal E Arcane Shift's cooldown quickly. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move beyond his range before his next attack triggers the bonus damage. When retreating at low health, change your angle to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Jhin.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Jhin's physical damage in the early game. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience.
Jhin.combo: For a standard trade, build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To close the distance on Jhin and start a fight, root him first with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then detonate the stacks that build during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and engage as soon as he starts reloading. Don't engage while his final shot is ready or when being hit by Jhin's basic attack or trap puts you at risk of Jhin W Deadly Flourish rooting you. Place Varus E Hail of Arrows along Jhin's retreat path and root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Jhin.fight: Close the distance while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots. Build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If you dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and are close enough, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Jhin.laning: Stand away from low-health minions so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade doesn't get stronger by bouncing off a kill. After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, detonate stacks built with basic attacks as you clear the wave. Don't walk up if you don't have lane priority.
Jhin.phase: Varus gets stronger as he builds items, but he has no mobility ability even in the late game, so hold your position in fights.
Jhin.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and position so your frontline takes Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin R Curtain Call shots first. When enemies group up, root them with Varus R Chain of Corruption and detonate stacks with Varus E Hail of Arrows followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance and the enemy's engage ability is down, move forward to the next target.
Jhin.watch: The final shot of Jhin P Whisper deals heavy damage, so retreat while it is ready. Right after being hit by Jhin's basic attack or trap, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. When your health is low, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Kalista.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Kalista’s main damage is physical and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Kalista.combo: Your basic trade is to build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To catch Kalista and start a fight, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Blighted Quiver stacks build while she is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, so detonate them with the two following abilities.
Kalista.escape: The window while Kalista R Fate’s Call is down is your chance to catch her with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Kalista must begin a basic attack animation to use Kalista P Martial Poise, so read that moment and hit her with Varus R Chain of Corruption or Varus E Hail of Arrows.
Kalista.fight: Stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate the stacks with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Hit Kalista with a skill as her basic attack animation begins. While Kalista R Fate’s Call is down, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption to start a fight.
Kalista.laning: Detonate the stacks you build on Kalista with basic attacks using Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If several spears are lodged in you, break vision by retreating into brush or behind a wall. If the enemy's engage tools and the jungler's position have not been confirmed, don't step forward and charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long.
Kalista.phase: Varus gets stronger as you build items, but he still has no mobility in the late game, so hold your position while fighting.
Kalista.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group together. If Kalista’s support stays near her, spread out to prepare for Kalista R Fate’s Call and be ready to apply crowd control at the expected landing point. After Kalista R Fate’s Call is down, find a spot to land basic attacks. If you contribute to the first takedown and trigger Varus P Living Vengeance, move on to the next target.
Kalista.watch: Rather than firing in response to Kalista P Martial Poise's hop, land Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow at the moment her basic attack animation begins. If health drops while several spears are lodged, Kalista E Rend can execute you, so disengage and stop fighting until the spears disappear. If Kalista's support stays close to her, watch for Kalista R Fate's Call and spread out in advance.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first to handle Kog'Maw's ability damage. Also consider armor to handle the physical damage from his basic attacks. Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
KogMaw.combo: For a standard trade, build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To root Kog'Maw and start a fight, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Detonate the Blighted Quiver stacks that build while Varus R Chain of Corruption roots him with the follow-up abilities.
KogMaw.escape: Engage after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires and you dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Kog'Maw has no mobility ability, so if Varus R Chain of Corruption roots him, it is difficult for him to create distance again. Right after killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.fight: Close the distance and fight after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. Build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Kog'Maw has no mobility ability, so after closing the distance, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption for a chance to kill him.
KogMaw.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, use it to clear the wave while denying Kog'Maw places to stand. Disrupt Kog'Maw's farming, but Varus has no mobility ability, so don't walk forward and charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long when you don't know the enemy jungler's position.
KogMaw.phase: Kog'Maw gets stronger as the game goes on, so disrupt his farming in the early and mid game, secure objectives and turrets, and play to end the game quickly.
KogMaw.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and root grouped enemies with Varus R Chain of Corruption. While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, avoid his long-range basic attacks and target him after it expires. Varus has no mobility ability, so don't walk forward to basic attack before the enemy's engage tools are down.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, his basic attack range increases and each basic attack deals damage based on your maximum health, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle lowers your armor and magic resistance, so block it from behind minions or dodge sideways, and avoid fighting briefly if it hits you. When your health is low, Kog'Maw R Living Artillery deals more damage, so move out of vision and recover.

MissFortune.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Miss Fortune’s main damage is physical and Varus has low armor, so build armor first. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: Your basic trade is to build as many Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To start a fight, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Blighted Quiver stacks build on Miss Fortune while she is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, so you can detonate them with the two following abilities.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so close the gap after the slow field from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain disappears. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time has started, you can interrupt it with Varus R Chain of Corruption and fight. Varus has no mobility, so don’t step forward if you can’t confirm the enemy’s engage tools or the jungler’s position.
MissFortune.fight: Stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate the stacks with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Miss Fortune has no mobility, so close the gap and hit her with Varus R Chain of Corruption to keep her in place. Delay your engage in the area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
MissFortune.laning: Stand to the side instead of directly behind a minion to avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Create distance right after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion. When harassing, build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks and detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If you don’t have lane priority, don’t step forward to aim; clear the wave with abilities.
MissFortune.phase: In the late game, Varus deals more damage, but he still has no mobility, so hold your position and advance only after the enemy’s engage tools are down.
MissFortune.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group together. Don’t fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active, and interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time with Varus R Chain of Corruption. If you contribute to a takedown, Varus P Living Vengeance makes you stronger, so move on to the next target right away.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces to targets behind minions, so don’t stand in a line with a minion. Right after Miss Fortune attacks a minion, create distance to guard against the empowered Miss Fortune P Love Tap. Don’t start a fight in the area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and when Miss Fortune R Bullet Time begins, interrupt it with Varus R Chain of Corruption or move out to the side of the cone.

Nilah.build: Nilah’s main damage is physical and Varus has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to help you survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so build health as well as armor instead of relying on armor alone. Handle healing reduction with Varus E Hail of Arrows first. If the enemy has several sources of healing, or heals somewhere Varus E Hail of Arrows can’t reach, take Mortal Reminder in place of an armor penetration item.
Nilah.combo: Your basic trade is to build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks after Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If you root Nilah with Varus R Chain of Corruption, detonate the Blighted Quiver stacks that build during the root with E and Q in turn. If Nilah is already close, fire Q immediately instead of holding to fully charge it.
Nilah.escape: The moment after Nilah engages first with Nilah E Slipstream and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil is your chance to root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and fight. E becomes available again after a short interval, so don’t engage just because her mobility is down; time your attack with R’s root. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, don’t group up with your allies to engage.
Nilah.fight: When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop basic attacking and respond with Varus Q Piercing Arrow or Varus E Hail of Arrows. After the veil ends, build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks and detonate them with E or Q. If Nilah closes in with Nilah E Slipstream, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and create distance.
Nilah.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, harass Nilah where she comes to last-hit, then detonate Blighted Quiver stacks built with basic attacks using E or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If you haven’t checked the availability of Nilah E Slipstream and the enemy jungler’s position, don’t step in front of the wave and charge Q for long.
Nilah.phase: In the late game, Varus still won’t gain mobility from building items, so you need to position where you can avoid Nilah’s engage to deal damage.
Nilah.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and spread out so Nilah R Apotheosis doesn’t catch several of you. If Nilah engages with Nilah E Slipstream and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and detonate Blighted Quiver stacks with E and Q. Don’t step forward to land basic attacks while Nilah’s engage tools are available. After a takedown contribution triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, pressure the next target.
Nilah.watch: If Nilah closes the gap with Nilah E Slipstream, Varus is in danger because he has no mobility, so place Varus E Hail of Arrows along her approach route. Move one step farther back right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, as her attack range increases. While Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled in together.

Samira.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Samira’s main damage is physical and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.combo: Your basic trade is to build as many Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If you start with Varus R Chain of Corruption after Samira W Blade Whirl ends, detonate the Blighted Quiver stacks that build during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows and Varus Q Piercing Arrow in turn.
Samira.escape: The moment after you force Samira to use Samira E Wild Rush is your chance to close the gap or pick her off. If you root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption then, she’ll have a hard time escaping. If the enemy’s engage ability is still available, avoid it first, then engage.
Samira.fight: Build Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and nobody has died, you have a chance to fight by rooting her with Varus R Chain of Corruption. If she gets close, fire Varus Q Piercing Arrow immediately instead of charging it for long.
Samira.laning: Use Samira’s short range to keep your distance, building Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks and detonating them with abilities. Hold Varus E Hail of Arrows for the path Samira would take to engage with Samira E Wild Rush. Don’t aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow in front of the wave before you know the enemy’s engage tools and the jungler’s position.
Samira.phase: Even after building items, Varus still has no mobility, so hold your position in the late game.
Samira.teamfight: Start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows from behind your frontline, and root enemies with Varus R Chain of Corruption when they group together. Don’t step forward to land basic attacks before Samira E Wild Rush is down. When Samira R Inferno Trigger begins, interrupt it with Varus R Chain of Corruption and place Varus E Hail of Arrows’s healing reduction zone where Samira will stand.
Samira.watch: Projectiles are destroyed while Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, so use Varus’s basic attacks and projectile abilities after the spin ends. A hit from allied crowd control can enable a dash with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so avoid the enemy’s engage first. If Samira gets close and builds Style, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so keep your time in close range short.

Senna.build: Start with Cloth Armor in the early game to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Senna’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Use Varus E Hail of Arrows’s healing reduction against the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Take Mortal Reminder in place of an armor penetration item only if the enemy has several sources of healing or heals somewhere Varus E Hail of Arrows can’t reach.
Senna.combo: Your basic trade is to build as many Blighted Quiver stacks as possible with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. To start a fight, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Blighted Quiver stacks build on Senna while she is rooted by R, so E and Q can each detonate the stacks.
Senna.escape: The moment Senna W Last Embrace misses is your chance to close the gap without worrying about being rooted. Senna has no mobility to create distance, so if you get close, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and attack. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, don’t wait there to engage; retreat or block her approach with Varus E Hail of Arrows.
Senna.fight: Harass Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul. For trades, build Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. After dodging Senna W Last Embrace, if you can close the gap, start a fight by rooting her with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls appear and attack when Senna approaches to prevent her from collecting them. Avoid the straight path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness, but stand behind minions so they can block Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.phase: Senna’s range and attack damage scale with the souls she collects in the late game, so Varus, who has no mobility, should hold his position while fighting.
Senna.teamfight: Harass from behind your frontline with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group together. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, retreat to a spot with vision or place E in the mist to block the approach. Use basic attacks after the enemy’s engage tools are down. If you contribute to a takedown and trigger Varus P Living Vengeance, attack the next target.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness pierces allies and minions in a straight line, so avoid positions where you line up with Senna and that target. Avoid Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if it hits you, move away from your allies before you are rooted. After Senna hits you once, retreat to prevent her from collecting mist by landing a second attack.

Sivir.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sivir’s main damage comes from the physical damage of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet, so build armor first.
Sivir.combo: Force out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then use Varus R Chain of Corruption to start a fight. For short trades, stack Blight with basic attacks, then use Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no blink or ability to create distance on her own, so when Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to catch her with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active, and look for an opening to fight after it ends.
Sivir.fight: For a standard trade, stack Blight with Varus’s basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Force out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption if an opportunity to close the gap arises.
Sivir.laning: If you leave Sivir alone in lane, she can quickly clear the wave and chip away at your turret, so push the wave first or have an ally catch it before you leave. When you don’t have lane priority, focus on clearing the wave instead of stepping forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Sivir.phase: In the late game, hold your position even once Varus has built up his items, since he has no mobility. Take only short fights while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.
Sivir.teamfight: From behind your frontline, disrupt the enemy formation with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. When Sivir E Spell Shield is down and enemies are grouped, start with Varus R Chain of Corruption; avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active. After you get a takedown, Varus P Living Vengeance empowers you, so immediately move on to the next target.
Sivir.watch: Avoid Sivir Q Boomerang Blade on both its outbound and return paths: dodge the first hit, then move out of the return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so don’t cast Varus R Chain of Corruption directly at Sivir while her shield is ready. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so avoid chasing and retreating slowly.

Tristana.combo: For short trades, stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. When starting a fight after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and detonate the stacks built during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows, then Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Use Varus W Blighted Quiver’s active only when you can reliably hit an empowered Q.
Tristana.escape: Right after Tristana W Rocket Jump is used, you have a chance to close the gap. If Tristana R Buster Shot is also ready, don’t go in recklessly; engage when you can catch her with Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Tristana.fight: For trades, stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Right after Tristana W Rocket Jump is used, take the chance to root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption and attack her.
Tristana.laning: In the early game, harass with the empowered basic attacks from Varus W Blighted Quiver. After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, detonate stacks as you clear the wave. Don’t stand close to allied minions, so you can avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Push Tristana toward her turret to make last-hitting difficult, but don’t overextend before checking Tristana W Rocket Jump and the enemy jungler’s position.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak in the early game, so harass her with Varus W Blighted Quiver and push the lane to pressure her. Tristana is difficult to deal with once she completes her build, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, then cast Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies are grouped. Don’t step forward to use basic attacks before Tristana W Rocket Jump is down. If an ally dies and Tristana W Rocket Jump resets, retreat immediately. After a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, attack the next target.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is a gap closer that lets her get on top of Varus, so don’t step forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long while it’s ready. Tristana R Buster Shot stuns and knocks you back, so hold a position where you can cast Varus R Chain of Corruption while both W and R are ready.

TwistedFate.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Twisted Fate’s damage. If you’re often caught by Gold Card stuns, buy Mercurial Scimitar earlier.
TwistedFate.combo: For a standard trade, stack Blight with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Twisted Fate R Destiny is down and you can catch him, start with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then detonate the Blight built during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows, followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
TwistedFate.escape: If Twisted Fate still has a Gold Card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, don’t approach or you may get stunned. Catch him with Varus R Chain of Corruption right after he uses the Gold Card or while Twisted Fate R Destiny is down.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while Twisted Fate is holding a Gold Card. If he’s holding a Blue or Red Card, or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, stack Blight with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
TwistedFate.laning: After learning Varus E Hail of Arrows, clear the wave by using E to detonate the Blight you’ve stacked with basic attacks.
TwistedFate.phase: In the late game, hold your position while fighting, even when Varus has high damage, since he has no mobility.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, then use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies are grouped. If Twisted Fate R Destiny appears and he’s in range, interrupt his movement with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Don’t step forward to use basic attacks while Twisted Fate R Destiny is still available. After a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, pressure the next target.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a Gold Card, it will stun you with one basic attack, so stay out of range. To reduce harass damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, stand behind minions.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building only one type of resistance will block only part of it; resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. Consider both your total health and how many basic attacks you can take.
Twitch.combo: A standard trade is to stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, and you can start a fight, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Detonate the stacks built while he’s rooted with both abilities.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, you have a chance to engage. After leaving the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption to prevent his escape.
Twitch.fight: Look for the moment Twitch Q Ambush ends and his position is revealed. Stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Twitch engages first, don’t spend a long time aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow; root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption to create distance.
Twitch.laning: If you’ve stacked Blight on Twitch with basic attacks, detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Twitch disappears from lane, alert your allies and don’t follow him into a bush where you have no vision.
Twitch.phase: In the late game, Varus gets stronger as he builds items, but he has no mobility, so hold your position and spread sideways out of the piercing path of Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Twitch.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. When Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals him, coordinate with your allies on a target and root that target with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Don’t line up with allies in the direction Twitch R Spray and Pray is firing. When a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, attack the next target.
Twitch.watch: When Twitch Q Ambush makes him disappear, don’t pass through bushes or narrow paths without vision. If Twitch W Venom Cask hits you, leave it immediately; after taking several basic attacks, create distance even if you still have health, and watch out for Twitch E Contaminate. If Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, his range is increased and his basic attacks pierce, so don’t line up with allies.

Vayne.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor can’t reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so don’t keep letting her hit you.
Vayne.combo: For a standard trade, stack Blight with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Vayne Q Tumble is down and you can reliably root her, use Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Detonate the Blight stacks built while she’s rooted with the follow-up abilities.
Vayne.escape: Close the gap right after Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are down. In particular, if you hit Vayne with Varus R Chain of Corruption right after she uses Vayne Q Tumble, she’ll have a hard time getting away. If both abilities are still available, don’t move near a wall.
Vayne.fight: Stack Blight with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Right after you force Vayne to use Vayne Q Tumble is your chance, so root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption to start a fight. Fight in an open area so Vayne E Condemn doesn’t push you into a wall.
Vayne.laning: Push the lane early while Vayne is weak to disrupt her farming. If you’ve stacked Blight with basic attacks, detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow before it fades. Varus has no mobility, so don’t stand in front of the wave to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long when you haven’t checked Vayne Q Tumble and the enemy jungler’s position.
Vayne.phase: Vayne has low health and armor in the early game, so Varus should push the lane to pressure her. In the mid game, turn that advantage into objectives and turrets. The more items Vayne gets, the harder she is to deal with, so pay extra attention to Varus’s positioning in the late game.
Vayne.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, and look for a chance to use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies are grouped. Don’t walk forward to use basic attacks while Vayne Q Tumble is still available. After a takedown empowers Varus with Varus P Living Vengeance, attack the next target.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn stuns you by knocking you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one. If Vayne keeps attacking the same target, Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on maximum health, so count the hits and get out of range before the damage triggers.

Xayah.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah’s damage is mostly physical and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Xayah.combo: For a standard trade, stack Blight to its maximum with Varus’s basic attacks, then hit her with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, start the fight with Varus R Chain of Corruption → Varus E Hail of Arrows → Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Blight stacks build while Varus R Chain of Corruption roots her, so detonate them with the follow-up abilities.
Xayah.escape: Don’t cast Varus R Chain of Corruption first while Xayah R Featherstorm is still available. Move sideways out of the root path from Xayah E Bladecaller before engaging.
Xayah.fight: Take short trades: stack Blight with Varus’s basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Xayah’s feathers build up if you stand in the same spot for too long, so reposition after a trade. Start a fight with Varus R Chain of Corruption when Xayah R Featherstorm is down.
Xayah.laning: Detonate the Blight you’ve stacked with basic attacks using Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Move sideways to avoid Xayah’s feather return paths, and don’t step forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow when you don’t have lane priority.
Xayah.phase: In the mid game, Varus R Chain of Corruption can start a fight, but first check whether Xayah R Featherstorm is down. In the late game, hold your position while fighting, even when Varus has high damage, since he has no mobility.
Xayah.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Once Xayah R Featherstorm is down, root grouped enemies with Varus R Chain of Corruption and follow up with abilities on targets who have Blight stacks. Don’t walk forward to use basic attacks before enemy engage abilities are down. When a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, move on to the next target.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers, so watch how many feathers are on the ground and their return paths. If feathers build up along a line between you and Xayah, move sideways to get off their path instead of retreating straight back. Check whether Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, since she can use it to dodge Varus R Chain of Corruption.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Varus has relatively low armor, so build armor early.
Yasuo.combo: Your basic trade is to build Blight with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. When you have an angle to avoid Yasuo W Wind Wall and Yasuo has difficulty escaping, root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then detonate the Blight that stacks with Varus E Hail of Arrows and Varus Q Piercing Arrow in sequence. If Yasuo is already on top of you, don’t fully charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow; fire it right away.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t engage just because he used it once. Fight by rooting him with Varus R Chain of Corruption right after he throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again.
Yasuo.fight: Poke off Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before committing to a full trade. If you safely build Blight stacks with basic attacks, detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Right after Yasuo uses the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, he has fewer ways to knock you up for a short time, so look to fight then.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and slightly pushed toward your side to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use. If you haven’t confirmed the engage path and the enemy jungler’s position, don’t step forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Yasuo.phase: In the early game, watch for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to close the distance, and use Varus W Blighted Quiver to poke and survive. In the late game, make the most of Varus’s damage as his items come online, but focus on positioning and managing distance since he has no mobility.
Yasuo.teamfight: Start from behind your frontline with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, and use Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies group together. If Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and Yasuo R Last Breath are available, don’t step forward to basic attack. If a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, use that advantage to attack the next target.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the distance, so don’t charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long in front of the wave. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, he can follow up with a tornado and Yasuo R Last Breath, so move out of its line and dodge to the side. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, save your key abilities until it disappears or you have an angle to go around it.

Zeri.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zeri’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on maximum health and can execute you, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health and watch its execute threshold.
Zeri.combo: Usually, stack Varus W Blighted Quiver as much as possible with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. If Zeri E Spark Surge is down, root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption, then detonate the stacks built during the root with Varus E Hail of Arrows followed by Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Zeri.escape: Engage right after Zeri E Spark Surge is down. If you root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption then, she’ll have a hard time getting away. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase on foot; first decide whether you can root her.
Zeri.fight: Right after you force Zeri to use Zeri E Spark Surge, you have a chance to close the gap and fight. Stack Varus W Blighted Quiver with basic attacks, then detonate it with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. While Zeri E Spark Surge is still available, don’t recklessly step forward, given Varus’s lack of mobility.
Zeri.laning: Use Zeri’s short basic attack range to build an advantage with basic attack harass before she gets her core items. Detonate the Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks you’ve built with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Don’t move in front of the wave to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long before you’ve checked Zeri E Spark Surge and the enemy jungler’s position.
Zeri.phase: In the early game, Varus can harass with his range and build an advantage before Zeri gets her core items. In the late game, hold your position while fighting, even when Varus has high damage, since he has no mobility.
Zeri.teamfight: From behind your frontline, start with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, and root grouped enemies with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Don’t walk forward to use basic attacks before Zeri E Spark Surge is down. When a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, use the empowered moment to move on to the next target.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, each hit increases her movement speed, so don’t chase on foot; catch her only when you can root her with Varus R Chain of Corruption. If your health is low, watch out for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery.

Ziggs.combo: Your basic trade is to build Blight to maximum stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, if you root him with Varus R Chain of Corruption, detonate the Blight that stacks during the root first with Varus E Hail of Arrows, then with Varus Q Piercing Arrow. When you’re close to him, don’t charge Varus Q Piercing Arrow for long; fire it right away.
Ziggs.escape: Ziggs W Satchel Charge is his only way to reposition, so right after he uses it is an opening for Varus to engage. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield has also been laid, approach from an open direction instead of walking through the mines. Rooting Ziggs with Varus R Chain of Corruption at this point makes it hard for him to escape.
Ziggs.fight: Build Blight stacks with basic attacks, then detonate them with Varus E Hail of Arrows or Varus Q Piercing Arrow. When Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, close the distance for a chance to lock him down with Varus R Chain of Corruption. Ziggs has relatively low armor, so Varus’s main source of physical damage is effective against him.
Ziggs.laning: Look to trade immediately after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities, or immediately after he uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke and clear the wave. When you don’t have the initiative, clear the wave instead of stepping forward to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow.
Ziggs.teamfight: Start from behind your frontline with Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows, and avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Open with Varus R Chain of Corruption when enemies are grouped, and look for a chance to root Ziggs if Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. If a takedown triggers Varus P Living Vengeance, move on to the next target.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you if you step on it, making follow-up abilities harder to dodge. Detour around the mines or wait for them to disappear. When you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the blast center even if you can’t get completely clear. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is still available, also check the routes Ziggs could use to escape over a wall.
